data.one_liner: HSV, HSL, RGB, and Material color picker widgets for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides highly customized color picker widgets out of the box, including ColorPicker, MaterialPicker, BlockPicker, and SlidePicker. Supports multiple color models and manual hex input.
use_when: You need to let users select colors via HSV, HSL, RGB, or Material palettes.
You want to display color selection inside a dialog or custom form.
avoid_when: You require advanced image-based color sampling rather than structured palette/slider pickers.
strengths: Multiple picker styles available (Material, Block, Slide, HSV/HSL/RGB)
Cross-platform support including web and desktop
weaknesses: Lacks advanced color blending tools or eyedropper screen sampling out of the box.

alternatives.name: flex_color_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative comprehensive color picker with extensive customization and theme building features.
